scripts.lint:hyphens: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),maqaf='\u05BE';let found=[];function scan(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f),s=fs.statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory()&&!['node_modules','.next','.git'].includes(f))scan(p);else if(/\.(tsx|ts|css|md)$/.test(f)){const lines=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').split('\n');lines.forEach((l,i)=>{if(l.includes(maqaf))found.push(p+':'+(i+1)+': '+l.trim())});}}}scan('src');if(found.length){console.error('Hebrew maqaf found:');found.forEach(x=>console.error(x));process.exit(1);}else{console.log('OK - no Hebrew maqaf');}"
